speaker: Raj
text: So, Sheldon, how's it feel to get beaten up by a girl? Gentlemen, have you come to the realization that the only reasonable course of action is to sell the ring and divide the money?

speaker: Sheldon
text: It's not the first time. I have a twin sister whose assaults began in utero. If only I'd had the presence of mind to reabsorb her, then I'd have a mole with hair in it instead of a tedious yearly Christmas letter. No.

speaker: Venkatesh Kutralpalli
text: Greetings from Mumbai. I am Raj's attorney, Venkatesh Kutralpalli. Don't answer that. I'll get straight to the point. My client's prepared to surrender any interest he has in the ring in exchange for two Kawasaki jet skis.

speaker: Sheldon
text: We're not giving him two jet skis.

speaker: Venkatesh Kutralpalli
text: Look, we're big boys. Why don't we just cut to the chase and meet in the middle? One Kawasaki jet ski, done and done.

speaker: Raj
text: Forget the jet skis. That was a line in the sand. What happened to tear them a new one?

speaker: Venkatesh Kutralpalli
text: What can I say? They played hardball. We lost. I told you that when you hired me.
